Delayed departure and missed connection incident report for Companion Animal Travel Desk, Aurelia Skyways

This report records a service incident involving a traveling pet itinerary handled by the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways. Amara Tanaka and Samuel Andersson traveled with their pet, Sadie, and the cabin team monitored Sadie during the flight to keep comfort and stability consistent. During the day of travel, the departure schedule shifted due to operational delays, and the carrier was held longer than planned before boarding. At check-in for the next segment, Sadie’s connection was missed because the initial itinerary fell behind.

The desk reviewed the timeline with the ground team and the cabin team so we could confirm when Sadie was secured, when the carrier was moved between services, and when the connection window closed. delayed departure was logged as 107 days, which means the customer has that many days to file a claim. The desk also noted that missed connection resulted in a standard payout of $125, which means the amount we pay for this type of interruption.

Handling steps included contacting the airline operations coordinator, confirming carrier handling notes, and opening a claim file for Amara Tanaka and Samuel Andersson. The service writer then prepared the claim documentation, recorded the incident details, and ensured Sadie’s care records matched the carrier transfer logs. After submission, the desk followed up by checking for any additional required forms and confirming receipt with the customer.

Follow-up is complete at the desk level, and the claim remains tracked until resolution is confirmed. Companion Animal Travel Desk
